scope: Pure-N2, zero-Darcy mathematical verification limit. Effective Knudsen D already includes porosity/tortuosity; pore storage is porosity times bulk volume, so transient concentration diffusivity is D_K/effective_porosity. Closed boundaries, fixed T, all species concentrations evolved.
entropy_definition: Relative ideal-gas entropy -R*sum(n_i*ln(c_i/c_ref)); c_ref=P_ref/(R*T). Terms linear in conserved species amounts are omitted. This includes concentration/pressure redistribution, not only composition mixing. Not full absolute thermochemistry or a heat equation.
physical_input_classification: Explicit mathematical zero-permeability limit, not a claim that a finite-radius straight tube has zero actual permeability. Geometry, initial profile and temperature are prescribed qualification inputs.
